description: Provision (or reprovision) a full environment — candidate-*, preview, or production — via the runner-owned `provision-env.yml` workflow. Covers the before (prereqs + minting secrets), the dispatch, the phase map, the hard-won gotchas that turn a "green" provision into a silent half-deploy, and the after (verify + decommission). Use when standing up a new env, reprovisioning a dead one, debugging a provision that "succeeded" but isn't serving, or when someone says "provision prod / candidate-b", "the new VM isn't up", "ImagePullBackOff after provision", "apex cut over to an empty VM", "525 after provision", "operator pod won't start". Sibling to `https://cognidao.org/knowledge/fork-quickstart-guide` (the forker's zero-to-green) — this is the operator's reference for ANY env on the hub.
